inputs.text: Folks, look at what we are dealing with here. We have the Senior Staff Association of Nigerian Universities (SSANU) issuing a one-month ultimatum to the federal government, demanding the conclusion of the long-delayed renegotiation of the 2009 agreement with non-teaching university unions. They are actually threatening an indefinite nationwide strike if their demands are unmet. This stems right out of the union’s 54th National Executive Council resolutions. It is a total collapse of basic discipline, a complete disregard for national stability, and a direct assault on the education of our youth. These agitators are choosing chaos and disruption over proper governance and national duty, showing that personal responsibility and accountability have been thrown out the window. We cannot let this kind of lawlessness dictate the terms of our society.
